title.original: AgentFly: Extensible and Scalable Reinforcement Learning for LM Agents
title.zh: AgentFly：面向语言模型智能体的可扩展强化学习框架
title.en: AgentFly: Extensible and Scalable Reinforcement Learning for LM Agents

inclusion_reason.zh: AgentFly 将多轮 mask、工具/奖励注册、异步执行和环境资源管理封装为通用智能体 RL 框架。
inclusion_reason.en: AgentFly packages multi-turn masking, tool and reward registration, asynchronous execution, and environment resource management into a general agent-RL framework.

abstract.zh: AgentFly 是可扩展的语言模型智能体 RL 框架，支持多轮交互、可插拔工具和奖励函数，并以异步执行和集中资源管理提高环境训练吞吐。
abstract.en: AgentFly is a scalable RL framework for language-model agents with multi-turn interaction, pluggable tools and rewards, asynchronous execution, and centralized resource management.

problem.zh: 传统 RL 接口面向单步或固定环境，难以表达智能体的多轮 token、外部工具调用和异构奖励计算，也缺少统一的扩展方式。
problem.en: Conventional RL interfaces target fixed or single-step environments and do not naturally represent multi-turn tokens, external tool calls, heterogeneous rewards, or extensible agent tasks.

approach.zh: 框架用 token 级 mask 适配传统 RL 算法，以装饰器定义工具与奖励，并异步执行工具调用和奖励计算来隐藏环境等待。
approach.en: The framework adapts standard RL algorithms with token-level masks, defines tools and rewards through decorators, and overlaps environment delay through asynchronous tool and reward execution.

system_design.zh: 训练器连接多轮轨迹缓冲区、工具/奖励注册表和环境协调器；集中资源管理器分配环境与算力，并让异步任务把完成的轨迹送回学习端。
system_design.en: A trainer connects a multi-turn trajectory buffer, tool and reward registries, and an environment coordinator; centralized resource management assigns capacity and returns completed trajectories asynchronously.

key_results.zh: 预置工具和环境上的实验表明，同一框架能够训练多类智能体任务，并通过异步执行维持较高吞吐。
key_results.en: Experiments with the included tools and environments show that one framework can train agents across several tasks while sustaining throughput through asynchronous execution.

limitations.zh: 集中资源管理可能成为超大规模瓶颈；token mask 对复杂信用分配仍较粗，工具副作用、安全隔离和真实 API 波动也未被充分覆盖。
limitations.en: Centralized resource management may bottleneck at extreme scale; token masking remains coarse for credit assignment, and tool side effects, sandboxing, and real-API variability are not fully covered.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件与基线均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未给出可安全转录的结果数字，表格明细与部署配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, and baselines come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; the abstract provides no result number safe to transcribe, and table details plus deployment configuration still require full-text audit.
